clue.text: Team is embroiled with match statistics etc.

indicators.note: being embroiled means being mixed up in a tangle, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A sports team gets tangled up in the numbers from a match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'embroiled' rearranges the letters of TEAM IS and MATCH together.
explanation.definitionFit: Statistics is one branch of the wider mathematical sciences, so 'statistics etc.' covers the whole field.

clue.text: A very small monarch, say

parts.note: taken as written; that the letters also run on through 'A very' is a coincidence, as the clue builds them piece by piece
the word very made small, i.e. abbreviated, is V
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the crossword monarch

explanation.surface: A tiny king or queen, for instance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'small' tells you to shorten 'very' to its abbreviation V; ER is the standard abbreviation for the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: To aver is to state or assert something firmly.

clue.text: Hurried to find concealment, as one might say

indicators.note: the phrase points to a word spoken out loud and spelt differently

parts.note: a hide is a hidden shelter used for watching birds or game

explanation.surface: Someone rushed off to find a place to hide.
explanation.walkthrough: A hide is a concealed shelter for watching wildlife; HIDE spoken out loud sounds like the old verb HIED.
explanation.definitionFit: Hie is an old word for hasten, so its past tense means went quickly.

clue.text: Plagues brought by small creatures, originators of terrible suffering

parts.note: moles are small burrowing mammals

indicators.note: the originators of words are their opening letters, here of terrible and suffering

explanation.surface: Plagues caused by little animals bring the start of terrible suffering.
explanation.definitionFit: To molest someone is to pester or harass them, as a plague troubles people.

clue.text: Garment, article obtained for journey north

indicators.note: in a down clue, travelling north means reading upwards, so the pieces run backwards

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
got means obtained

explanation.surface: A piece of clothing acquired to wear on a trip northwards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for journey north' reverses A GOT, giving TOGA when read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The toga was the loose outer robe worn by citizens of ancient Rome.

clue.text: Having ribs in firm condition

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
state means condition

explanation.surface: Someone whose ribs are in good, solid shape.
explanation.definitionFit: Costate is a botanical and anatomical adjective for something bearing ridges like ribs.

clue.text: The get-up for one who's got up

definitions.text: The get-up for one who's got up

parts.words: The get-up for one who's got up
parts.note: a get-up is an outfit, and someone who has got up has mounted a horse

explanation.walkthrough: 'got up' sounds like rising from bed, but here means climbing into the saddle.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the special outfit of jacket and breeches worn by a horse rider.

clue.text: I help with a cargo, possibly coming from Indonesia?

indicators.note: possibly signals that these letters may be arranged another way

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone offers to help with a shipment arriving from Indonesia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges I HELP and A CARGO; the question mark marks Indonesia as just one example.
explanation.definitionFit: Indonesia is an example of a nation made up of a great chain of islands.

clue.text: By the sound of it, drop a level

indicators.note: this signals a word heard rather than read, spelt another way

parts.note: a tear is a drop from the eye

explanation.surface: Someone apparently letting fall a single level.
explanation.walkthrough: TEAR (a drop from the eye) spoken out loud sounds like TIER.
explanation.definitionFit: A tier is one of several rows or layers stacked one above another.

clue.text: Expert who may look up a tree

definitions.text: Expert who may look up a tree

parts.words: Expert who may look up a tree
parts.note: the tree is a family tree, which this researcher consults rather than climbs

explanation.walkthrough: The picture is of someone peering up into branches, but the tree is a family tree.
explanation.definitionFit: This specialist traces family descent and ancestry.

clue.text: Expression of regret when tourist attraction falls short

indicators.note: falling short means the word ends before its last letter

parts.note: a sight is something tourists go to see

explanation.surface: Someone sighs when a famous landmark disappoints.
explanation.walkthrough: 'falls short' cuts the final T from SIGHT.
explanation.definitionFit: A sigh is a long breath let out in sadness or disappointment.

clue.text: Fellow giving firm ideas for making money?

definitions.text: Fellow giving firm ideas for making money?

parts.words: Fellow giving firm ideas for making money?
parts.note: read as a man who gives a company its plans for profit, combining a firm with a fellow

explanation.walkthrough: The clue also hints at the parts: a firm (BUSINESS) and a fellow (MAN).
explanation.definitionFit: This is a man who works in commerce, running or planning a company's trade.

clue.text: Trees in rows demonstrating an untidy quality

indicators.note: in places the trees inside the rows

parts.note: rows (rhyming with cows) are quarrels, scraps
pines are trees

explanation.surface: Trees planted in rows show a messy look.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rows' looks like lines of trees but means arguments, pronounced to rhyme with 'cows'.
explanation.definitionFit: Scrappiness is the state of being disorganised, bitty and messy.

clue.text: Coarse leader leaving meal, having not favoured being inside

indicators.note: being inside shows one piece sitting within the other
the leader is the first letter, which leaves the word

parts.note: lunch is a meal
out means out of favour, unfashionable

explanation.surface: A rude man leaves dinner, having been unpopular among the company.
explanation.walkthrough: 'meal' plus 'leader leaving' leaves UNCH; 'not favoured' is OUT, as in out of fashion, and 'being inside' places it before the final letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Uncouth means rough, crude and lacking in manners.

clue.text: Poet's residence north of river

indicators.note: in a down clue, north of means placed above, so first

parts.note: a home is a residence

explanation.surface: A poet's house stands to the north of a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Homer is the ancient Greek poet credited with the Iliad and the Odyssey.

clue.text: Street operation with clothes store providing temporary measure

parts.note: Gap is a chain of clothing shops

explanation.surface: A street works project combined with a clothes shop gives a short-term fix.
explanation.walkthrough: Gap is an American clothing retailer with shops in many countries.
explanation.definitionFit: A stopgap is something used for the time being until a proper replacement is found.

clue.text: Dismissal — male's accepted nasty blow

indicators.note: something accepted is taken in, so one piece goes inside

parts.note: the sack is dismissal from a job
M is the abbreviation for male; the 's is 'is'

explanation.surface: A man has been fired and takes it as a cruel blow.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'male's accepted' as 'male is taken in': M goes inside SACK.
explanation.definitionFit: A smack is a sharp slap or hard hit.

clue.text: A number, about a thousand, in battle

indicators.note: about means around, so one piece goes round another

parts.note: some means a number of
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: Some thousand or so took part in a battle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like 'roughly', but means SOME wraps around M.
explanation.definitionFit: The Somme was a major First World War battle fought in northern France in 1916.

clue.text: Italy organised another country

parts.note: I is the international vehicle registration for Italy
ran means managed or organised

explanation.surface: Italy set up a different nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Iran is a nation in western Asia, formerly called Persia.

clue.text: Season in which female is ahead of everybody

indicators.note: one piece placed in front of the other

parts.note: all means everybody

explanation.surface: A time of year when women lead the pack.
explanation.walkthrough: This is the American name for autumn.
explanation.definitionFit: In American usage this is autumn, the time of year when leaves drop.

clue.text: Hope a chap can embrace this lovely girl

indicators.note: the words hold the answer inside them, as if embracing it

explanation.surface: A hope that a man will hug this attractive young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can embrace' says the answer is held within HOPE A CHAP.
explanation.definitionFit: Peach is informal for a very attractive or pleasing person.

clue.text: Do supper for many, but turn away outsiders

indicators.note: the outer letters are sent away, leaving the inner run of the words

explanation.surface: Cook dinner for a crowd, but refuse strangers at the door.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn away outsiders' removes SUP and ANY from SUPPER FOR MANY, leaving the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: To perform is to carry out or execute an action.

clue.text: Bad time in dance? One is 'peaky'!

indicators.note: in places one piece within another

parts.note: a hop is an informal dance
ill means bad

explanation.surface: Feeling unwell at a dance and looking peaky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'peaky' normally means pale and sickly, which fits 'bad time'; here it means having a peak.
explanation.definitionFit: The top of a rise is the very peak, a summit point.

clue.text: Give authority to English politician or … We'll get trapped!

parts.note: MP is a Member of Parliament

indicators.note: being trapped means being caught inside something

parts.note: taken as written
the word we, with 'll meaning will

explanation.surface: An English MP or someone else; either way, we will be caught.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis is just for the surface; split 'We'll' as 'we will', so 'get trapped' puts the pronoun inside the word 'or'.
explanation.definitionFit: To empower someone is to authorise them or grant them official power.

clue.text: What nanny may be doing is teasing

definitions.meaning: a nanny goat gives birth to young goats

explanation.walkthrough: 'nanny' suggests a childminder, but she is a female goat.
explanation.definitionFit: A goat giving birth produces kids, and the same word means joking with someone.

clue.text: Perfume said to make one ecstatic

indicators.note: said shows the word is spoken, so the spelling may differ

parts.note: scent is perfume

explanation.surface: A fragrance said to bring someone joy.
explanation.walkthrough: SCENT spoken out loud sounds like SENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Sent is old slang for thrilled or transported with delight.

clue.text: A revolutionary student event? It could be part of the culture

definitions.text: It could be part of the culture

indicators.note: revolutionary means turning over, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: rag is a British student charity event

explanation.surface: A radical student happening might become part of the culture.
explanation.walkthrough: A rag is a British university fundraising week; the culture is a culture of bacteria grown in a lab.
explanation.definitionFit: Agar is the jelly on which bacteria are grown in a laboratory dish.

clue.text: Fairy in endless danger

indicators.note: endless means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: peril means danger

explanation.surface: A fairy in a dangerous situation without end.
explanation.definitionFit: A peri is a sprite or spirit from Persian mythology.

clue.text: Get around, having got rid of a bit of an illness

indicators.note: getting rid of something removes it from the word

parts.note: about means around

explanation.surface: Being out and about after shaking off a minor illness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having got rid of a' removes A from ABOUT; 'Get' is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A bout is a short spell or attack of something, such as flu.

clue.text: Remember this writer for a particular plant

definitions.meaning: a plea from the writer not to be forgotten
a small flower with blue blossoms

explanation.walkthrough: The plea 'don't forget me' is said three words long, and is also the name of a small blue flower.
explanation.definitionFit: This small blue flower's name is a plea to be remembered, which the writer is making.

clue.text: A particular orchestra as an add-on

parts.note: LSO is the London Symphony Orchestra

explanation.surface: One specific orchestra joins as an extra.
explanation.definitionFit: Also means in addition, as an extra.

clue.text: I am in favour of holiness, keeping right — opposing this, therefore

parts.note: I'm is a contraction of I am
pro means in favour of

indicators.note: keeping means holding something inside

parts.note: piety means holiness

explanation.surface: Someone supports holiness and the right, so they oppose wrongdoing.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition follows from the wordplay: one who favours piety and right must oppose bad conduct.
explanation.definitionFit: Impropriety is improper behaviour, which a lover of goodness would oppose.
